text:
I didn't have any side effects while taking this drug.
Although, out of all of the medicines I have taken, this one was the worst to come off of.
I couldn't speak as well
and I had HORRIBLE brain zaps.
I am now back on the medicine.
Out of all of the psychotrophic drugs that I have taken (and there has been A LOT of them)
this one has been the most beneficial.
I would highly reccomend this one!
